title: Zoho Desk Adds Blended AI Agents with Human Oversight #Shorts
description:
Learn how to configure Zoho Desk blended AI agents to automate support tasks safely with human oversight.

1. Go to Zoho Desk Setup and open the AI / Zia Agent configuration menu.
2. Enable blended agents and set safety boundaries for autonomous task execution.
3. Configure escalation rules so complex tickets automatically route to human agents.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

angle.problem: Support managers fear AI agents will give incorrect information to customers without supervision.
angle.solution: Zoho Desk now features blended AI agents that pair autonomous AI task execution with human support oversight.
steps: Go to Zoho Desk Setup and open the AI / Zia Agent configuration menu.
Enable blended agents and set safety boundaries for autonomous task execution.
Configure escalation rules so complex tickets automatically route to human agents.
angle.result: Automate routine customer tasks while ensuring human supervision keeps responses accurate and safe.
angle.wow: Blended AI agents handle the heavy lifting while automatically handing off tricky edge cases to human reps.
angle.hook: Zoho Desk just added blended AI agents - here's how to keep human oversight!
